units.locator: Article 62. Economic basis of local self-government
units.text: 1. The economic basis of local self-government comprises municipally owned property, including the property rights of municipalities, and local budget funds.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Economic basis of local self-government
units.text: 2. In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, municipal ownership is recognized and protected by the state on an equal basis with other forms of ownership.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 62

units.text: Article 63. Municipal property
units.label: Art. 63

units.text: 1. Municipalities may own:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 63

units.text: 1) property intended for addressing the matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life established by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 63

units.text: 2) property intended for exercising individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies in cases established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 63

units.text: 3) property intended for supporting the activities of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials, municipal servants and employees of municipal enterprises and institutions in accordance with regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 63

units.text: 4) property necessary for exercising powers not assigned to the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 63

units.text: 5) property necessary for local self-government bodies to participate in the exercise of state powers not transferred to them and exercised in accordance with Article 36 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 63

units.text: 2. Where municipalities acquire ownership of property that does not meet the requirements of part 1 of this Article, that property shall be repurposed (its designated purpose changed) or alienated. The procedure and time limits for alienating such property shall be established by federal law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 63

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.label: Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 1. On behalf of the municipality, local self-government bodies shall independently possess, use and dispose of municipal property in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws and regulatory legal acts of local self-government bodies adopted pursuant to them.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies have the right to acquire property into municipal ownership, transfer municipal property for temporary possession and/or use to individuals and legal entities and public authorities, including local self-government bodies of other municipalities, alienate it and enter into other transactions in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 3. The procedure and conditions for privatization of municipal property shall be determined by regulatory legal acts of local self-government bodies in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 4. Revenue from the use and privatization of municipal property shall be credited to local budgets.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 5. Municipalities may establish municipal enterprises and institutions and participate in establishing business companies, including intermunicipal companies, necessary for exercising powers to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life. The functions and powers of the founder in relation to municipal enterprises and institutions shall be exercised by authorized local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 6. On behalf of the municipality, local self-government bodies shall bear subsidiary liability for the obligations of municipal treasury-funded institutions and ensure performance of those obligations in accordance with the procedure established by federal law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 7. Local self-government bodies shall maintain registers of municipal property in accordance with the procedure established by the federal executive authority authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Possession, use and disposal of municipal property
units.text: 8. Local self-government bodies shall transfer municipally owned electric-grid facilities for gratuitous possession and use to the system-forming territorial grid organization or territorial grid organization operating within the boundaries of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in the cases, in accordance with the procedure and on the conditions established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the electric power industry.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 64

units.text: Article 65. Local budgets
units.label: Art. 65

units.text: 1. Each municipality has its own budget (local budget).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 65

units.text: 2. Revenue and expenditure estimates for individual settlements and other territories that are not municipalities may be provided for as a constituent part of municipal budgets.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 65

units.text: 3. The procedure for drawing up, approving and executing the estimates specified in part 2 of this Article shall be determined independently by the local self-government bodies of the corresponding municipalities, in compliance with the requirements established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 65

units.text: 4. Local self-government bodies shall independently draw up and consider the draft local budget, approve and execute the local budget, monitor its execution, and draw up and approve the report on execution of the local budget, in compliance with the requirements established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 65

units.text: 5. The budgetary powers of municipalities, local self-government bodies and local self-government officials shall be established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 65

units.text: 6. The territorial bodies of the federal executive authority authorized to exercise control and supervision in the field of taxes and levies shall provide municipal financial bodies with information on the assessment and payment of taxes and levies to be credited to the budgets of the corresponding municipalities, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 65

units.text: 7. The head of the financial body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug shall be appointed from among persons meeting the qualification requirements established by the federal executive authority authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 65

units.text: 8. Verification of whether candidates for the position of head of the financial body of an urban okrug or municipal okrug meet the qualification requirements shall be carried out with the participation of the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. The procedure for participation by the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in that verification shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 65

units.text: 9. The law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation specified in part 8 of this Article shall provide for a list of documents to be submitted to the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, methods of verifying candidates’ compliance with qualification requirements, including interviews with candidates, and a list of decisions adopted following such verification and the form of the opinion on its results. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may also regulate other matters concerning the procedure for participation by the financial body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in such verification.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 65

units.text: 10. The draft local budget, the decision approving the local budget, the annual report on its execution, quarterly information on the progress of execution of the local budget and on the number of municipal servants in local self-government bodies and employees of municipal institutions, indicating the actual expenditure on their remuneration, shall be officially published.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 65

units.text: 11. Equalization of municipalities’ budgetary capacity shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 65

units.text: Article 66. Local budget expenditure
units.label: Art. 66

units.text: 1. Local budget expenditure shall be formed in accordance with the expenditure obligations of municipalities established and fulfilled by the local self-government bodies of those municipalities in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 66

units.text: 2. Municipalities’ expenditure obligations shall be fulfilled from the funds of the corresponding local budgets in accordance with the requirements of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 66

units.locator: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.text: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.label: Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.text: 1. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs shall be carried out in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Procurement to meet municipal needs
units.text: 2. Procurement of goods, works and services to meet municipal needs shall be financed from the local budget, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 67

units.text: Article 68. Local budget revenue
units.label: Art. 68

units.text: Local budget revenue shall be formed in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, legislation on taxes and levies and legislation on other mandatory payments.
units.label: Art. 68 · text

units.text: Article 69. Citizens’ self-taxation funds
units.label: Art. 69

units.text: 1. Citizens’ self-taxation funds mean one-off payments made by citizens to address specific matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life. The amount of payments under citizens’ self-taxation shall be set as an absolute amount equal for all residents of the municipality (a settlement (part of a settlement’s territory) forming part of the territory of the municipality), except for certain categories of citizens whose number may not exceed 30 per cent of the total number of residents of the municipality (a settlement (part of a settlement’s territory) forming part of the territory of the municipality) and for whom the amount of payments may be reduced.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 69

units.text: 2. Matters concerning the introduction and use of the one-off payments by citizens specified in part 1 of this Article shall be decided at a local referendum or, in the cases provided for in points 1 and 2 of part 1 of Article 45 of this Federal Law, at a citizens’ assembly.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 69

units.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.text: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.label: Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.text: 1. The source of financing for implementation of the initiative projects provided for in Article 49 of this Federal Law shall be the budget appropriations for implementation of initiative projects provided for in the local budget, formed taking into account, among other things, the amounts of initiative contributions and/or interbudgetary transfers from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation provided to finance the corresponding expenditure obligations of the municipality.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.text: 2. Initiative contributions mean funds of citizens, individual entrepreneurs and legal entities formed in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, paid voluntarily and credited to the local budget in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation to implement specific initiative projects.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.text: 3. If an initiative project has not been implemented, the initiative contributions shall be returned to the persons (including organizations) that transferred them to the local budget. If, upon completion of an initiative project, a balance remains of initiative contributions not used for its implementation, those contributions shall be returned to the persons (including organizations) that transferred them to the local budget.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.text: 4. The procedure for calculating and returning the amounts of initiative contributions to be returned to the persons (including organizations) that transferred them to the local budget shall be determined by a regulatory legal act of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Financial and other support for implementation of initiative projects
units.text: 5. Implementation of initiative projects may also be supported through voluntary contributions of property and/or labour by interested persons.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Expenditure obligations of municipalities arising in the performance of state powers of the Russian Federation transferred to local self-government bodies for exercise shall be financed from the federal budget by providing subventions to local budgets from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Subventions for exercising state powers of the Russian Federation transferred to local self-government bodies shall be provided from the federal budget to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for distribution among local budgets for those purposes in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Provision of subventions to local budgets for the exercise of state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. Expenditure obligations of municipalities arising in the performance of state powers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation transferred to local self-government bodies for exercise by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be financed from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation by providing subventions to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation adopted pursuant to it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. To co-finance expenditure obligations arising in the performance of the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, subsidies may be provided to local budgets from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted pursuant to it.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted pursuant to them, grants and other interbudgetary transfers may be provided to local budgets from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 72

units.locator: Article 72. Subsidies, grants and other interbudgetary transfers provided to local budgets from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, other grants may be provided to the budgets of individual municipalities from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, financed by grants provided from the federal budget to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for those purposes. The distribution of such grants among municipalities shall be approved by the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by a regulatory legal act of the highest executive state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the distribution approved by the federal law on the federal budget or a legal act of the Government of the Russian Federation, if grants for two or more municipalities are provided to the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 72

units.text: Article 73. Municipal borrowing
units.label: Art. 73

units.text: Municipalities have the right to undertake municipal borrowing, including by issuing municipal securities, in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipality.
units.label: Art. 73 · text

units.locator: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets
units.text: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets
units.label: Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets
units.text: 1. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for subsidies and other interbudgetary transfers from local budgets to the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements and in the cases established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 74

units.locator: Article 74. Interbudgetary transfers provided from local budgets
units.text: 2. Subsidies and other interbudgetary transfers may be provided to the budgets of municipalities from the budgets of other municipalities in accordance with the requirements and in the cases established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 74

units.text: 1. Intermunicipal cooperation shall take the following forms:
